text:
jess: Heads up — saw repeated NIC TX drops on gpunode-17 around 12:10 UTC. Correlates with a bunch of ephemeral fractional slices kicking off parallel batch tokenization + outbound S3/curls. Trace below.

```
[12:10:02] tx_drops=48 qlen=256 iface=eth0 host=gpunode-17
[12:10:03] tx_drops=91 qlen=512 iface=eth0 host=gpunode-17
[12:10:04] connected_allocs=[alloc-a378, alloc-b199] tenants=[tenant-lowpri, tenant-b]
```

priya: Is this RDMA or just regular TCP egress? @samir any net-side obs?

samir: Not RDMA — 100% TCP. Looks like tokenizers are doing many small requests to our artifact store (lots of SYN/ACKs) and bulk curl uploads. NIC TX qlen spikes and qdisc starts dropping. Similar to warm-pool warmup noise we saw last month.

ops-bot: ALERT: egress_tx_errors=142 on gpunode-17 (window=5m). Linked allocations: alloc-a378, alloc-b199. Trigger: egress_tx_errors > 100.

ryan: We should avoid an immediate mass-evac — if we push everything off gpunode-17 at once we'll just hotfill other hosts. Proposal: a sequenced evacuation (30s stagger + preflight neighbor-busy check) so we don't create a cascade. Also add a soft-route to a dedicated fallback pool for lowpri tenants if capacity exists.

jess: +1. Short-term mitigation: per-tenant egress policing (token-bucket) for fractional slices until we implement NIC-aware placement. That should shave the tail and reduce retransmits.

priya: Quick cost check — routing affected requests to the dedicated fallback increases GPU + egress cost ~20% for those requests (more reserved capacity). Are we okay eating that for SLA-sensitive customers?

samir: For incidents we should yes. Longer term we need NIC-aware scheduler: add an "egress_hot" tag and avoid co-locating with egress-sensitive tenants. Also investigate qdisc tuning (fq_codel) for burst smoothing.

maria: Can infra run a canary for the sequencer + egress-policing in eu-west next week? I'll open a ticket and coordinate with oncall.

jess: Filed TICKET-8214 for canary + design doc. Quick config mitigation: apply fq_codel tweaks on affected host class to reduce queueing delay. @ops-bot can you schedule rolling config to /etc/sysctl.d/egress-qdisc.conf for the gpu fleet?

ops-bot: Scheduled rolling job cfg-1092: deploy /etc/sysctl.d/egress-qdisc.conf (fq_codel params) to 30 hosts in batch size 5. Start in 2h UTC.

ryan: I'll prototype the sequencer (evac order + jitter + preflight check) today and push a PR. Will ping here when demo is ready. :thumbsup:

jess: Thanks — let's avoid aggressive handoffs and prefer soft-routing where possible. Keep the thread updated if the canary/rollout shows any backpressure.
